offers_products.reason: Sells investment management services, not manufactured goods or software; funds are managed by staff.

offers_services.reason: Active asset management: equity, fixed income, liquidity and private markets funds managed for clients.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Retail investors buy its mutual funds and active ETFs, often through advisors.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Institutional investors, corporations and municipalities use its money market and liquidity funds and private markets strategies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Earns ongoing management fees on assets in funds, mainly money market funds held continuously.

cyclical_demand.reason: Money market and liquidity funds are core cash management; clients keep holding them in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Fund investments are ongoing fee-based holdings, not large one-time purchases like homes or machinery.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue is asset-based fees on funds and platform scale, not billed hours of staff time.

large_customers.reason: Money market and liquidity business serves large institutions, corporations, banks and governments, plus intermediaries.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset manager needs investment teams and offices, not plants, fleets or networks.

notes: Mix of retail and institutional buyers; the institutional liquidity business is judged the larger part.
